OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU

OpenAI says invisible watermarks reach EU ChatGPT and Codex text within weeks. The Decoder reports detection hits 95 percent on clean text and 17 percent once a quarter of words change.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-eu-text-watermark/

Cohere launches North 2 agent platform with memory and token spending caps

Cohere says North 2 lets enterprise agents remember context between sessions and caps token spend per user and per agent. It runs in the cloud, on premises or fully air-gapped.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-cohere-north-2/
